name: Granite-4.1-LLMON-preview (3B and 8B)

lineage.how_derived: instruct fine-tune to read prompts in LLMON (LLM Object Notation, arXiv 2603.22519): every prompt part is an addressable block and an exec block names the instruction, inputs and output location

purpose: Consume prompts in the LLMON structured-block format instead of a conventional chat template; the builder states no further purpose in the part of the card read.
